content.text: The evidence clearly shows a feature flag (`monthly-spend-feature`) being toggled from off to on around 15:45-15:46, and the error rate rising in lockstep — a `ZeroDivisionError` in `spend_summary.py:47` starts firing exactly as the flag ramps from 58/200 to 100% on. No deployment or config change was recorded in the lookback window, ruling out bad-deployment/config-induced-failure. This is a feature-flag toggle causing a code path with a division-by-zero bug to activate.

hypotheses.subject: monthly-spend-feature
hypotheses.summary: The monthly-spend-feature flag was toggled from off to on across 15:45-15:46, activating a code path (spend_summary.py:47) that divides by zero whenever it runs, driving the account page error rate from baseline ~1% to 30-36%. No deployment or config change occurred in the preceding day, so the only recorded change coincident with onset is the flag flip.
